title: Plasmon Modes in Three-Dimensional Multifold Semimetals. II. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl and Kramers-Weyl Nodes
summary: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional multifold semimetals in which multiple bands cross the Fermi level at a positive chemical potential, focusing on pseudospin-3/2 Rarita—Schwinger—Weyl semimetals and on Kramers—Weyl semimetals. Both systems host multiple concentric Fermi surfaces at positive chemical potential. Within the random-phase approximation, we analyse the density response, Drude weights, dielectric function, plasmon modes and their Landau damping, and Friedel oscillations, considering both small and arbitrary momentum transfers.
